thread.title: Sirius XM To Buy Pandora Media In $3.5 Billion Deal | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Sirius XM To Buy Pandora Media In $3.5 Billion Deal | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Sirius XM Holdings ( SIRI ) plans to buy Pandora Media ( P ) in an all-stock transaction valued at $3.5 billion, the two digital radio companies announced Monday morning . The merger had long been rumored.
X Sirius XM is a leader in subscription radio channels while Pandora offers advertising-supported streaming music as well as an ad-free, on-demand music service. The existing brands, products and services will continue after the merger, they said. The combined company expects to have more than $7 billion in pro forma revenue in 2018.
Pandora's music platform will enable Sirius XM to expand its presence beyond mostly in-car entertainment into the home and on mobile devices.
Sirius XM has more than 36 million subscribers across North America, plus over 23 million annual trial listeners. Pandora has more than 70 million monthly active users. The merger creates the world's largest audio entertainment company, the companies said in a news release.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Pandora shareholders will receive 1.44 newly issued Sirius XM shares for each Pandora share they hold. The implied purchase price of Pandora is $10.14 per share, based on a 30-day average of Sirius XM stock value.
Deal Dilutive To Sirius Shareholders The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2019. It is subject to approval by Pandora shareholders, regulatory clearance and other closing conditions.
Pandora stock jumped as much as 10.1% in early trading on the stock market today . But it ended the regular session down 1.2% to 8.98. Sirius XM tumbled 10.3% to 6.26.
Evercore ISI analyst Vijay Jayant said the deal will be dilutive for Sirius shareholders in the near to medium term. That's because of the significant share issuance at Sirius and the lack of earnings or free cash flow at Pandora, he said.
"Overall, we understand the rationale for the combination, which provides potential revenue synergies on both the Pandora and Sirius XM platforms," he said. Jayant rates Sirius stock as in-line with a price target of 6.
Management likely will use Pandora as a way to funnel more customers to Sirius XM's subscription service. It also could use some Sirius content to drive listening and ad revenue on Pandora, he said.
Financial Guidance Reaffirmed "The addition of Pandora diversifies Sirius XM's revenue streams with the U.S.'s largest ad-supported audio offering, broadens our technical capabilities, and represents an exciting next step in our efforts to expand our reach out of the car even further," Sirius XM Chief Executive Jim Meyer said in a statement. "Together, we will deliver even more of the best content on radio to our passionate and loyal listeners, and attract new listeners, across our two platforms."
Along with the merger announcement, Sirius XM and Pandora reiterated their previous financial guidance.
Sirius XM maintained its full-year outlook. It expects revenue over $5.7 billion, adjusted earnings of about $2.175 billion, and free cash flow of about $1.5 billion.
Pandora kept its third-quarter guidance. It expects revenue of $390 million to $405 million and an adjusted loss of $10 million to $25 million.
Sirius XM and Pandora are two of the oldest players in the digital music space. In recent years, they have faced growing competition from subscription music-on-demand services from Spotify ( SPOT ), Apple ( AAPL ), Amazon.com ( AMZN ) and others.
Satellite radio broadcasters Sirius and XM merged in July 2008 to form Sirius XM.
Streaming content now accounts for 75% of U.S. music industry revenue, the Recording Industry Association of America said in its midyear 2018 report last week.
